references.adopted: ReadEncrypted framing, 32-byte XOR/PRNG/checksum algorithm and constants; four-alignment physical scan strategy; 60 xx 00 u8-length literal search as analysis-only evidence.
modifications: Split archive codec from script-candidate analysis; standard-library-only independent modules.
Bound allocations, input windows, header/literal counts, attempted decode bytes and output bytes; explicit corruption and budget diagnostics.
Read cross-window headers and frames from complete input; fixed little-endian scanning, unique starts and physical order.
Retain short, empty and unquoted blocks and header low bits; report incomplete checksum coverage.
Preserve duplicate literals, raw CP932 bytes, controls, resources and invalid candidates; no blanket exception swallowing.
Do not adopt heuristic name/message exports, global deduplication, data-dropping filters, full-VM claims or unproven archive patching.
New-directory analysis workspace with original physical frames, decoded data and candidate-only metadata; actual encoder roundtrip required per decoded frame.

references.use: Cross-check ReadEncrypted size relation, per-full-chunk checksums, PRNG, key constants and RIO object signature using the already bundled source excerpt.
